material.locator: WESO 2023, Chapter 3 “Working conditions of key workers”, sections on working hours and wages; Chapter 1 “Who are the key workers?”.
material.description: The report provides an independent international example using employment, wages and working-time dimensions. It does not independently establish the full statistical indicator family, especially productivity and labour underutilization; those components are supported by the ILOSTAT locators in the primary Evidence Use record.
